exposure: application of Llama 3.0 LLM to clinical notes
outcome: identification of surgical site infections (SSI) by LLM
cohort: The cohort consisted of 28 patients (14 with surgical site infection and 14 controls) from two metropolitan hospitals, primarily involving caesarean section and arthroplasty patients.
finding: The Llama 3.0 LLM demonstrated high accuracy (93%), sensitivity (100%), and good specificity (86%) in identifying surgical site infections from clinical notes, often flagging cases on or before the onset date.
